reason: Reviewed the complete 2023 Annual Report for GFT Technologies SE. The document contains extensive information about the company's business segments (Americas, UK & APAC; Continental Europe), revenue breakdown by service portfolio (Platform Modernisation 53%, Engineering Services & Regulatory 39%, AI & Data 8%), strategic initiatives including AI.DA Marketplace, cloud services, and digital banking solutions. However, no Total Addressable Market (TAM) figures are disclosed by the company itself. All content relates to actual company performance, service offerings, and strategic positioning rather than market opportunity sizing.
